Question 2
?

The equation x2−2x+1=1 can be written in the form (x+p)2=q. Find pq, and the sum of the roots x1+x2.

a
pq=1 and x1+x2=2
b
pq=−1 and x1+x2=1
c
pq=0 and x1+x2=2
d
pq=−1 and x1+x2=−1
e
pq=−1 and x1+x2=2
Submit
